description: Read back a codice fiscale: sex, birth date (one or two possible centuries), birth comune or foreign state valid on that date, the consonant codes of surname and name, and omocodia. The full name cannot be recovered from a code. Fails with the reason when the format or the check character is wrong.

code.description: Codice fiscale, 16 characters (spaces and lowercase accepted).

name: decode_codice_fiscale
title: Decode a codice fiscale (inverso)
